VERDICT done_when: a test in tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py builds a one-skin annular unit (outer-only and inner-only) and asserts extract_vessel_shells returns that one closed shell; the existing vessel tests pass; 'uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit' adds no failure against base and 'uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ink tests' adds no finding against base's 55.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares imas_ink/extract.py, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py, docs/evidence/fragments/geometry-figure-vessel-units/ink-one-skin.html and the figure directory docs/figures/geometry-figure-vessel-units/ink-one-skin; the diff over 78ce779..420b205 touches exactly the first three (80 insertions, 6 deletions) and no file outside the declaration; the declared figure directory was not written and section 4 requires no figure.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the fix, the base/head gate figures, and a negative control that reddens the two new one-skin tests; every declared field is filled and status is 'complete'.
VERDICT diff: read 2c5cfec (imas_ink/extract.py +18/-6, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py +55) and 420b205 (the evidence fragment, +13); the guard changes from 'inner is not None and outer is not None' to 'inner is not None or outer is not None' with each filled outline appended independently, inner before outer; the docstring and inline comment are updated to state the one-per-filled-outline rule.
CALL_SITES: extract_vessel_shells is the only function changed and _shell_from_outline/_filled_outline are reused unchanged; the function has callers through extract_geometry and the renderers but its signature and return type are unchanged, and a both-filled unit produces byte-identical shells (vessel_0_inner, vessel_0_outer) to before.
SCORE goal_fidelity: 20
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: the branch now emits one shell per filled outline and 'continue's, so a one-skin unit no longer reaches the centreline/outline fall-through; independently reproduced here: at base 78ce779 an outer-only and an inner-only unit both returned 0 shells, and at head 420b205 they return one closed shell each (vessel_0_outer r_max 7.0, vessel_0_inner r_max 5.0) while a both-filled unit still returns vessel_0_inner, vessel_0_outer; no public name is added, matching the section.
SCORE evidence: 19
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the reviewed run's own baseline_suite and after_suite logs are the gate evidence: base ends '1 failed, 400 passed, 6 skipped, 34 deselected, 14 warnings, 4 errors' at 78ce779 and head ends '1 failed, 402 passed, ... 4 errors' at 2c5cfec, and the FAILED/ERROR id sets are identical (the single test_no_wall_renders_without_overlay failure plus four test_scene_cutaway.py setup errors), so added_failure_count is 0; ruff_base and ruff_head both end 'Found 55 errors.'; the focused file re-runs green here at 420b205 (15 passed); the negative control (requiring both outlines) was independently reproduced here, reddening exactly the two new tests (2 failed, 13 passed, EXIT=1) which pass at head; the only reservation is that the suite gate ran at 2c5cfec and the docs-only commit 420b205 followed, so the final head was not itself the gated revision.
SCORE scope_discipline: 20
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff --stat over 78ce779..420b205 lists exactly imas_ink/extract.py, tests/unit/test_vessel_units.py and docs/evidence/fragments/geometry-figure-vessel-units/ink-one-skin.html, all inside the manifest's declared write paths; no file outside the declaration changed and the declared figure directory was left unwritten, which the section does not require.
SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: two tests, one per skin direction, each assert the shell count is exactly 1, the name is vessel_0_outer/vessel_0_inner, is_closed is True and an r_max bound (outer > 6.9, inner < 5.1), so the assertion of the name rules out the centreline/outline fall-through shadowing the skin; the negative control reddens both, showing they measure the branch rather than a fixed pattern; the existing both-skin test and the file's other extraction tests still pass (15 in the file); a both-filled unit's unchanged behaviour is covered by the pre-existing tests and confirmed here, though the new class does not itself re-assert the both-skin case.
SCORE fit: 20
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change is a two-line guard widening plus a duplicated append in the existing annular branch, keeps the documented read order (filled outlines, then centreline, then outline), updates the docstring and comment to the mechanism, adds no public name, and introduces no plan label, version number, ticket or author attribution; the helper names TestAnnularOneSkin, _make_one_skin_vessel_unit and _make_one_skin_wall_ids name the behaviour.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the fix reuses _filled_outline for both probes and _shell_from_outline for both emissions rather than forking a path, and does not touch the centreline or outline fall-backs; the smallest correct change for the section.
FINDING(no follow-on): no residual defect found; the one-skin names remain vessel_{i}_inner / vessel_{i}_outer and correctly identify the filled outline.
